title: Shared Codex app-server is not in a kill-on-close job, so its process tree (including Engram MCP children) is not guaranteed to end when TermAl exits
outcome: The shared Codex app-server and its whole process tree are assigned to a kill-on-close job at spawn (suspended, attached, then resumed), as spawn_dedicated_runtime does, so they end whenever TermAl exits.
acceptance: Shared Codex app-server is not in a kill-on-close job, so its process tree (including Engram MCP children) is not guaranteed to end when TermAl exits is done
